messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 tail-latency spike detected on /v1/generate (hosted) in us-west-2. 30m spike, p95->420ms, p99->2.1s, streaming stalls observed. Trigger: latency-slo-breach. Paging oncall: @casey_oncall.
casey_oncall: on it — jumping into traces now. any customer-facing errors?
support-bot: Several customers reported slow streaming frames (chunk gaps) and timeouts to our SDKs. 6 distinct orgs showing elevated error rates (~0.8%).
maya_singh: I'm seeing a big jump in control-plane RPC latencies to configstore and auth during the window. config_fetch latency p95 ~600ms -> 1.8s; auth token fetch p95 ~~450ms -> 1.2s. DB RCU on token-store had spikes too.
devin_lang: grabbing logs from inference-gw and runtime. There's a backlog in the request queue where requests are waiting on auth/feature-eval path. kv-cache lookups are fine.
samir_khan: quick snapshot of metrics: 
- ingress qps: steady
- runtime cpu/gpu: normal
- auth db connections: saturated (max conn ~ 200, bursts to 380)
- configstore 503s: small bump (~0.5%)
- featureflag eval latency: p99 ~1.7s during spike

samir_khan: attaching query sample from token-store logs:
```
ERROR tokendb: timeout retrieving token for client_id=acme-corp svc=token-store timeout=2s
stack: sql: conn timeout
```

casey_oncall: hypothesis: auth/token-store DB contention + featureflag/config fetch is adding serial blocking to request path, causing streaming tail stalls. Need live mitigations: 1) bypass featureflag eval for streaming paths (use cached default), 2) route auth token verification to read-replica or degrade to JWT-only check, 3) increase token-store pool temporarily. Thoughts?
jules_product: customer impact: heavy streaming customers will see stally responses and possible reconnects. We should prepare a short customer note if mitigation will take >15m.
maya_singh: I can push a quick Canary patch to runtime to skip remote flag eval when header X-Stream-Frame=true; that'll return cached flag defaults. It's a small fast path change.
devin_lang: On the infra side, we can scale token-store horizontally (k8s HPA) and temporarily raise DB max connections and connection_timeout. I'll coordinate with eng-infra. But DB host is near CPU limit for a bit.
casey_oncall: Action items:
- maya: patch skip-flag-canary (runtime) and route 10% of streaming traffic to canary.
- devin: HPA token-store + bump DB conn pool, open RDS support ticket if CPU stays high.
- samir: put a short-lived rate-window on config-fetch retries to avoid thundering herd.
- jules: draft customer note.

maya_singh: pushed PR: skip-flag-canary -> runtime/master. Deploying as canary 10%. Logs show reduced featureflag eval latency for canary buckets.

devin_lang: token-store HPA up to 4 replicas, DB pool param increased from 200->400 via parameter group apply (rolling). Observed conn saturation receding.
support-bot: SDK retries: observed many clients retrying aggressively after chunk stalls. Suggest we throttle client-side retry guidance in note.

samir_khan: after mitigations, p95 dropped to ~260ms, p99 to ~480ms on /v1/generate for canary and overall trending down. Streaming chunk gap metric decreased by 70% for canary.

casey_oncall: Confirming no errors escalated to 5xx rate >1% now. Monitoring for 15m.
jules_product: Draft to customers: short explanation + guidance to upgrade SDK to 2.4.1 which includes backoff. Asking for review.

maya_singh: root cause timeline draft: 
- 11:02 UTC: a rollout increased featureflag evaluation pressure (new flag store sharding change) 
- 11:04 UTC: token-store experienced connection storms from retrying control-plane clients during rollout
- 11:05-11:18 UTC: serial blocking on auth/config path caused tail latency and streaming backpressure

casey_oncall: Postmortem notes to collect: configstore rollout metadata, token-store connection metrics, client retry amplification, runtime flag-eval hot-path. Also mitigation timeline + canary deploy artifact.

devin_lang: recommend long term fixes: backpressure at ingress for control-plane calls, local flag cache for streaming sessions, circuit breaker on token-store, and better DB autoscaling.

jules_product: customer note approved, sending via status.redwood.ai and to affected orgs ops channels.

casey_oncall: marking incident as mitigation-in-progress. Handoff: @devin_lang will monitor next 2 hours. I'll update the incident tracker with links and assign owners for postmortem.

samir_khan: leaving a short checklist for postmortem: 
- dump DB slow logs (token-store)
- correlate SDK retry spikes with client IDs
- audit featureflag rollout change and revert window
- plan for read-replica routing for auth-checks

casey_oncall: thanks team. If anything regresses ping #incidents immediate. closing page but keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
